tasks.short: Count cash by hand for deposit.

steps.what: Run the existing currency-counting machine
Compare the counted total with the stored balance
Count currency, coins, and checks by hand
Prepare the counted money for deposit or shipment
Sign the counted shipment
File the signed counted shipment
outputs: filed copy of signed counted shipment v1

tasks.design: The existing currency-counting machine in {BANK} already runs, and that time is not a saving. A new job compares the counted total with the stored balance. The teller counts currency, coins, and checks by hand and prepares the shipment. A later job files the signed shipment in {DOCS}. It does not send the cash.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bundle totals were copied before the hand count.
tasks.enabler_now: Bundle identifier and machine total are already stored.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides the shipment is ready.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week counting, not on the existing machine.

reach.task: Accept only the shipment the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.
The executive digest says a match is posted only on an exact amount, and any miss stops with a person.

assumptions: Bundle identifier, machine total, and hand total are stored on the deposit record. The deposit record produces the machine total. A blank total stays blank and is not treated as zero.
Native configuration of the deposit record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the teller counting currency by hand.

incremental.description: Refresh bundle identifier and counted total when the deposit layout changes, and drop a shipment the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many machine totals are blank. The high end assumes bundle identifier and machine total are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored fields for the customers' transactions
Enter customers' transactions into the computers
Check the record before any receipt is issued
Sign the transaction entry
Issue computer-generated receipts for the signed entry
outputs: filed copy of signed receipt v1

tasks.design: A job lists the stored fields in {ERP}. The teller enters the customers' transactions into the computers and checks the record. A later job issues computer-generated receipts only for the signed entry. It does not record an unsigned transaction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Receipts were typed again after the entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Transaction identifier and amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The teller still takes the transaction at the window.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides the entry is complete.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the entry, not on reprinting the receipt.

reach.task: Keep only the receipt the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says most of these figures are arithmetic on records, and interest charges are configuration or plain code.
The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.

assumptions: Transaction identifier, account, and amount are stored on the ledger record. The ledger record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not printed on the receipt.
Native configuration of the ledger record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining entry is still the teller entering the transactions.

incremental.description: Refresh transaction identifier and amount when the ledger layout changes, and drop a receipt the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many transaction amounts are blank. The high end assumes transaction identifier and amount are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List checks missing dates or bank names
Examine checks for endorsements and dates
Verify identification and the legality of documents
Sign the document check
File the signed document check
outputs: filed copy of signed document check v1

tasks.design: A job lists checks in {BANK} that are missing a date or a bank name. The teller examines endorsements and verifies identification and the legality of the documents. A later job files the signed check in {DOCS}. It does not use biometrics, and a blank date is not treated as present.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dates and names were read into a fresh sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Check identifier, date, and bank name are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Legality is still judged by the teller.
tasks.human_edge: The teller accepts or refuses the document.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the document, not on listing blank dates.

reach.task: Pay only the document the teller accepted

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.
Digest [S16] says fingerprint clocking was fined. This design does not use biometrics.

assumptions: Check identifier, date, bank name, and endorsement flag are stored on the document record. The document record produces them. A blank date or bank name stays blank and is shown as a gap. Identification is not a biometric check.
Native configuration of the document record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining examination is still the teller examining endorsements.

incremental.description: Refresh check identifier, date, and bank name when the document layout changes, and drop a check the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many dates or bank names are blank. The high end assumes check identifier, date, and bank name are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List account discrepancies in the stored figures
Resolve problems or discrepancies on customers' accounts
Decide the correction for that discrepancy
Sign the account correction
File the signed account correction
outputs: filed copy of signed account correction v1

tasks.design: A job lists account discrepancies in {ERP} where stored figures do not match. The teller resolves the problems on the customers' accounts and decides the correction. A later job files the signed correction in {DOCS}. It does not change the balance by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Discrepancies were copied before the conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Account identifier and both amounts are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The customer still has to be heard.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the account, not on finding the mismatch.

reach.task: Hear only the correction the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a match is posted only on an exact amount, and any miss stops with a person.
The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.

assumptions: Account identifier, stored amount, and presented amount are stored on the account record. The account record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not treated as a discrepancy of zero.
Native configuration of the account record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining work is still the teller resolving the discrepancy.

incremental.description: Refresh account identifier and both amounts when the ledger layout changes, and drop a correction the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many compared amounts are blank. The high end assumes account identifier and both amounts are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teller spends the week at the window, on the cash, and on the signed amount. A stored total, a fee from a stored rule, and filing that signature can move. The teller still counts the cash, checks the signature, and releases the payment.
reach: A customer receives only the amount the teller signed.
A colleague posts only the deposit the teller signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a payout that the teller has not signed.
Reject a fee that does not match the stored rule.
Reject a balance that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed payout or statement can go out the same day, and the teller still owns the cash.
